SELECT
  event_timestamp,
  TransactionID,
  probability_fraud,
  is_fraud,
  latency_ms,
  endpoint_name,
  n_records,
  status,
  CASE
    WHEN LAG(event_timestamp) OVER (PARTITION BY endpoint_name ORDER BY event_timestamp) IS NULL
      THEN 'Cold Start'
    WHEN event_timestamp - LAG(event_timestamp) OVER (PARTITION BY endpoint_name ORDER BY event_timestamp) > INTERVAL 5 MINUTES
      THEN 'Cold Start'
    ELSE 'Warm Start'
  END AS start_type
FROM fraud_detection_dev.bronze.monitoring_raw_events

dimensions.name: start_type
dimensions.comment: Cold Start = first request after 5+ min gap or initial request; Warm Start = subsequent requests within 5 min

measures.name: avg_latency_ms
measures.comment: Average HTTP round-trip latency per individual scoring request

measures.name: p50_latency_ms
measures.comment: Median latency across individual HTTP requests

measures.name: p95_latency_ms
measures.comment: 95th percentile latency across individual HTTP requests

measures.name: p99_latency_ms
measures.comment: 99th percentile latency across individual HTTP requests

measures.name: avg_latency_per_record_ms
measures.comment: Total latency divided by total predictions — normalized per-prediction cost

measures.name: total_predictions
measures.comment: Sum of n_records across all HTTP requests — actual prediction count

measures.name: total_requests
measures.comment: Count of individual HTTP scoring requests (batches)

measures.name: error_rate_pct
measures.expr: 100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN status != 'success' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*)
measures.comment: Percentage of HTTP requests returning non-success status

dimensions.name: fraud_label
dimensions.expr: CASE WHEN is_fraud = 1 THEN 'Fraud' ELSE 'Legitimate' END

config.source: SELECT 'Train' AS source, TransactionAmt, CAST(target AS BIGINT) AS is_fraud FROM fraud_detection_dev.gold.fraud_features WHERE split = 'train' UNION ALL SELECT 'Production' AS source, TransactionAmt, is_fraud FROM fraud_detection_dev.gold.model_predictions

WITH train_unpivoted AS (
  SELECT variable_name, value FROM (
    SELECT TransactionAmt, C4, C5, D3, D4, D5, V3, V5, V7, dist1
    FROM fraud_detection_dev.gold.fraud_features WHERE split = 'train'
  ) UNPIVOT (value FOR variable_name IN (TransactionAmt, C4, C5, D3, D4, D5, V3, V5, V7, dist1))
  WHERE value IS NOT NULL
), prod_unpivoted AS (
  SELECT variable_name, value FROM (
    SELECT TransactionAmt, C4, C5, D3, D4, D5, V3, V5, V7, dist1
    FROM fraud_detection_dev.gold.model_predictions
  ) UNPIVOT (value FOR variable_name IN (TransactionAmt, C4, C5, D3, D4, D5, V3, V5, V7, dist1))
  WHERE value IS NOT NULL
), train_stats AS (
  SELECT variable_name, MIN(value) AS min_val, MAX(value) AS max_val
  FROM train_unpivoted GROUP BY variable_name
), train_binned AS (
  SELECT u.variable_name, WIDTH_BUCKET(u.value, s.min_val, s.max_val, 10) AS bin_num
  FROM train_unpivoted u JOIN train_stats s ON u.variable_name = s.variable_name
), prod_binned AS (
  SELECT u.variable_name, WIDTH_BUCKET(u.value, s.min_val, s.max_val, 10) AS bin_num
  FROM prod_unpivoted u JOIN train_stats s ON u.variable_name = s.variable_name
), train_pct AS (
  SELECT variable_name, bin_num, COUNT(*) * 1.0 / SUM(COUNT(*)) OVER (PARTITION BY variable_name) AS pct
  FROM train_binned GROUP BY variable_name, bin_num
), prod_pct AS (
  SELECT variable_name, bin_num, COUNT(*) * 1.0 / SUM(COUNT(*)) OVER (PARTITION BY variable_name) AS pct
  FROM prod_binned GROUP BY variable_name, bin_num
) SELECT t.variable_name,
  SUM((COALESCE(p.pct, 0.0001) - t.pct) * LN(COALESCE(p.pct, 0.0001) / NULLIF(t.pct, 0.0001))) AS psi_value,
  CASE
    WHEN SUM((COALESCE(p.pct, 0.0001) - t.pct) * LN(COALESCE(p.pct, 0.0001) / NULLIF(t.pct, 0.0001))) < 0.1 THEN 'Stable'
    WHEN SUM((COALESCE(p.pct, 0.0001) - t.pct) * LN(COALESCE(p.pct, 0.0001) / NULLIF(t.pct, 0.0001))) < 0.25 THEN 'Warning'
    ELSE 'Unstable'
  END AS status
FROM train_pct t LEFT JOIN prod_pct p ON t.variable_name = p.variable_name AND t.bin_num = p.bin_num GROUP BY t.variable_name

WITH train_unpivoted AS (
  SELECT variable_name, value FROM (
    SELECT TransactionAmt, C4, C5, D3, D4, D5, V3, V5, V7, dist1
    FROM fraud_detection_dev.gold.fraud_features WHERE split = 'train'
  ) UNPIVOT (value FOR variable_name IN (TransactionAmt, C4, C5, D3, D4, D5, V3, V5, V7, dist1))
  WHERE value IS NOT NULL
), prod_unpivoted AS (
  SELECT variable_name, value FROM (
    SELECT TransactionAmt, C4, C5, D3, D4, D5, V3, V5, V7, dist1
    FROM fraud_detection_dev.gold.model_predictions
  ) UNPIVOT (value FOR variable_name IN (TransactionAmt, C4, C5, D3, D4, D5, V3, V5, V7, dist1))
  WHERE value IS NOT NULL
), combined_stats AS (
  SELECT variable_name, MIN(value) AS min_val, MAX(value) AS max_val
  FROM (
    SELECT variable_name, value FROM train_unpivoted
    UNION ALL
    SELECT variable_name, value FROM prod_unpivoted
  ) combined GROUP BY variable_name
), train_binned AS (
  SELECT u.variable_name,
    LEAST(GREATEST(WIDTH_BUCKET(u.value, s.min_val, s.max_val, 100), 1), 100) AS bin_num
  FROM train_unpivoted u JOIN combined_stats s ON u.variable_name = s.variable_name
), prod_binned AS (
  SELECT u.variable_name,
    LEAST(GREATEST(WIDTH_BUCKET(u.value, s.min_val, s.max_val, 100), 1), 100) AS bin_num
  FROM prod_unpivoted u JOIN combined_stats s ON u.variable_name = s.variable_name
), train_pct AS (
  SELECT variable_name, bin_num,
    COUNT(*) * 1.0 / SUM(COUNT(*)) OVER (PARTITION BY variable_name) AS pct
  FROM train_binned GROUP BY variable_name, bin_num
), prod_pct AS (
  SELECT variable_name, bin_num,
    COUNT(*) * 1.0 / SUM(COUNT(*)) OVER (PARTITION BY variable_name) AS pct
  FROM prod_binned GROUP BY variable_name, bin_num
), all_bins AS (
  SELECT variable_name, bin_num
  FROM (SELECT DISTINCT variable_name FROM train_unpivoted) v
  CROSS JOIN (SELECT EXPLODE(SEQUENCE(1, 100, 1)) AS bin_num)
), train_pct_filled AS (
  SELECT a.variable_name, a.bin_num, COALESCE(t.pct, 0) AS pct
  FROM all_bins a
  LEFT JOIN train_pct t ON a.variable_name = t.variable_name AND a.bin_num = t.bin_num
), prod_pct_filled AS (
  SELECT a.variable_name, a.bin_num, COALESCE(p.pct, 0) AS pct
  FROM all_bins a
  LEFT JOIN prod_pct p ON a.variable_name = p.variable_name AND a.bin_num = p.bin_num
), train_cum AS (
  SELECT variable_name, bin_num,
    SUM(pct) OVER (PARTITION BY variable_name ORDER BY bin_num) AS cum_cdf
  FROM train_pct_filled
), prod_cum AS (
  SELECT variable_name, bin_num,
    SUM(pct) OVER (PARTITION BY variable_name ORDER BY bin_num) AS cum_cdf
  FROM prod_pct_filled
) SELECT t.variable_name,
  MAX(ABS(t.cum_cdf - p.cum_cdf)) AS ks_statistic,
  CASE
    WHEN MAX(ABS(t.cum_cdf - p.cum_cdf)) < 0.1 THEN 'Stable'
    WHEN MAX(ABS(t.cum_cdf - p.cum_cdf)) < 0.2 THEN 'Warning'
    ELSE 'Unstable'
  END AS status
FROM train_cum t JOIN prod_cum p ON t.variable_name = p.variable_name AND t.bin_num = p.bin_num GROUP BY t.variable_name

WITH train_unpivoted AS (
  SELECT variable_name, value FROM (
    SELECT TransactionAmt, C4, C5, D3, D4, D5, V3, V5, V7, dist1
    FROM fraud_detection_dev.gold.fraud_features WHERE split = 'train'
  ) UNPIVOT (value FOR variable_name IN (TransactionAmt, C4, C5, D3, D4, D5, V3, V5, V7, dist1))
  WHERE value IS NOT NULL
), prod_unpivoted AS (
  SELECT variable_name, value FROM (
    SELECT TransactionAmt, C4, C5, D3, D4, D5, V3, V5, V7, dist1
    FROM fraud_detection_dev.gold.model_predictions
  ) UNPIVOT (value FOR variable_name IN (TransactionAmt, C4, C5, D3, D4, D5, V3, V5, V7, dist1))
  WHERE value IS NOT NULL
), train_stats AS (
  SELECT variable_name, MIN(value) AS min_val, MAX(value) AS max_val
  FROM train_unpivoted GROUP BY variable_name
), train_binned AS (
  SELECT u.variable_name,
    LEAST(GREATEST(WIDTH_BUCKET(u.value, s.min_val, s.max_val, 10), 1), 10) AS bin_num
  FROM train_unpivoted u JOIN train_stats s ON u.variable_name = s.variable_name
), prod_binned AS (
  SELECT u.variable_name,
    LEAST(GREATEST(WIDTH_BUCKET(u.value, s.min_val, s.max_val, 10), 1), 10) AS bin_num
  FROM prod_unpivoted u JOIN train_stats s ON u.variable_name = s.variable_name
), train_pct AS (
  SELECT variable_name, bin_num,
    COUNT(*) * 1.0 / SUM(COUNT(*)) OVER (PARTITION BY variable_name) AS pct
  FROM train_binned GROUP BY variable_name, bin_num
), prod_pct AS (
  SELECT variable_name, bin_num,
    COUNT(*) * 1.0 / SUM(COUNT(*)) OVER (PARTITION BY variable_name) AS pct
  FROM prod_binned GROUP BY variable_name, bin_num
), all_bins AS (
  SELECT variable_name, bin_num
  FROM (SELECT DISTINCT variable_name FROM train_unpivoted) v
  CROSS JOIN (SELECT EXPLODE(SEQUENCE(1, 10, 1)) AS bin_num)
), train_pct_filled AS (
  SELECT a.variable_name, a.bin_num, COALESCE(t.pct, 0) AS pct
  FROM all_bins a LEFT JOIN train_pct t ON a.variable_name = t.variable_name AND a.bin_num = t.bin_num
), prod_pct_filled AS (
  SELECT a.variable_name, a.bin_num, COALESCE(p.pct, 0) AS pct
  FROM all_bins a LEFT JOIN prod_pct p ON a.variable_name = p.variable_name AND a.bin_num = p.bin_num
), train_cum AS (
  SELECT variable_name, bin_num,
    SUM(pct) OVER (PARTITION BY variable_name ORDER BY bin_num) AS cum_cdf
  FROM train_pct_filled
), prod_cum AS (
  SELECT variable_name, bin_num,
    SUM(pct) OVER (PARTITION BY variable_name ORDER BY bin_num) AS cum_cdf
  FROM prod_pct_filled
), psi_calc AS (
  SELECT t.variable_name,
    SUM((COALESCE(p.pct, 0.0001) - t.pct) * LN(COALESCE(p.pct, 0.0001) / NULLIF(t.pct, 0))) AS psi_value
  FROM train_pct_filled t
  LEFT JOIN prod_pct_filled p ON t.variable_name = p.variable_name AND t.bin_num = p.bin_num
  GROUP BY t.variable_name
), ks_calc AS (
  SELECT t.variable_name,
    MAX(ABS(t.cum_cdf - p.cum_cdf)) AS ks_statistic
  FROM train_cum t JOIN prod_cum p ON t.variable_name = p.variable_name AND t.bin_num = p.bin_num
  GROUP BY t.variable_name
) SELECT
  COALESCE(p.variable_name, k.variable_name) AS variable_name,
  p.psi_value,
  CASE
    WHEN p.psi_value < 0.1 THEN 'Stable'
    WHEN p.psi_value < 0.25 THEN 'Warning'
    ELSE 'Unstable'
  END AS psi_status,
  k.ks_statistic,
  CASE
    WHEN k.ks_statistic < 0.1 THEN 'Stable'
    WHEN k.ks_statistic < 0.2 THEN 'Warning'
    ELSE 'Unstable'
  END AS ks_status
FROM psi_calc p FULL OUTER JOIN ks_calc k ON p.variable_name = k.variable_name ORDER BY p.psi_value DESC, k.ks_statistic DESC
